strategies.name: Direct Sequential All-Reduce Chain
strategies.desc: Applies 16 sequential all_reduce operations with interleaved local scale/divide operations, matching the reference pattern. Dispatch count is 16 all_reduce calls plus local operations. Represents the baseline: maximizes correctness transparency, accepts high dispatch overhead, no fusion opportunities.

strategies.name: Fused Scale-AllReduce with Buffering
strategies.desc: Pre-computes scaling patterns and merges consecutive scale→all_reduce→unscale triplets into single dispatches by fusing local arithmetic before and after each collective. Targets ~8 dispatches by fusing pairs of the original 16-step chain. Trades increased local computation complexity for halved collective dispatch count.

strategies.name: Pipelined Dual-Buffer Overlap
strategies.desc: Uses two rotating buffers to overlap computation of iteration i+1's scaling while iteration i's all_reduce is in flight, enabling pipeline parallelism across the 16 dependent operations. Dispatch count remains 16 all_reduce but hides local arithmetic latency. Trades memory (2x buffers) for latency hiding.

strategies.name: Hierarchical Reduce-Scatter All-Gather Decomposition
strategies.desc: Replaces each all_reduce with reduce_scatter (producing W chunks) followed by all_gather, allowing per-rank ownership of scaling operations on local shards between RS and AG phases. Results in 32 collectives (16×2) but with smaller per-dispatch payloads (1/W size). Trades collective count for bandwidth efficiency on large world_size.

strategies.name: Vectorized Multi-Shard Batched All-Reduce
strategies.desc:
Reshapes the tensor to expose shard structure explicitly, batches multiple all_reduce operations by stacking scaled versions into higher-dimensional tensors, then applies single batched collective calls. Achieves 4-8 dispatches by batching 2-4 iterations per call. Trades memory layout complexity and temporary storage for reduced dispatch overhead.
